resonant_ore.name: Resonant Ore
resonant_ore.lore: It hums at one note. The Mineral Offering on the quarry floor wants it.

titan_key.name: Titan Key
titan_key.lore: Opens the cairn-door to the Titan's Cairn.

waves.say: The pillars begin to ring. The cave answers.

onDone.text: The ringing stops on a clean note. A lump of Resonant Ore rests on the plate.
Winches drag the rockfall aside. A gorge winds on beyond.

onStep.text: A winch ratchets. The second lever.

mechanics.jam: The winch is jammed. The north lever first.

onDone.text: Scree pours away from a hidden tunnel in the north-east wall.

mechanics.doneText: The stones settle on the right note.

onOpen.text: The ore rings in its cradle. The gate in the quarry ditch grinds open.

mechanics.hint: A block of iron with a hollow cut for a lump of ore.
mechanics.verb: sets the Resonant Ore in the cradle and the ditch gate grinds open.

onOpen.text: The cairn-door of the Titan's Cairn rolls aside.

mechanics.hint: A door of fitted boulders, a keyhole carved between two of them.
mechanics.verb: turns the Titan Key and the boulder door rolls aside.

encounters.say: Bones jut from the walls. Some of what is in here is not a fossil.
The quarry steps down into a pit. A ringing block waits on the floor; stone levers line the south wall.

bosses.name: The Titan
bosses.intro: The Titan shrugs off a cairn of boulders. Shatter the three amethyst wards on the pillars to crack its stone hide.
bosses.deathText: The Titan crumbles back into a heap of stones.

shield.breakText: The wards shatter! The Titan is bare!
shield.relapseText: The wards reform and The Titan calls its servants.

completion.intro: The Titan's Cairn. Clear the rockfall, brave the gorge, and ring the ore on the quarry floor.
completion.message: The stones settle. The cairn closes shortly.
